title: casuarina stricta var. fraseriana
intro: Casuarina stricta var. fraseriana, commonly known as the 'Dunbar Oak' or 'Australian Pine', is a species of flowering plant in the family Casuarinaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat various health conditions, such as skin infections, respiratory issues, and inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Casuarina stricta var. fraseriana have been found to exhibit potential health benefits, including wound healing, immune system modulation, and anti-cancer properties.
